scientific_question: At which DuckDB operator stage does a wide sensitive value actually become observable work when it is pruned, hashed, materialized, aggregated, or sorted around the same Join?
mechanisms: Mask before Join with a materialized boundary
Mask after Join in a fused pipeline
raw payload materialization before post-Join Mask
required_evidence: result digest equivalence within every semantic group
distinct physical-plan fingerprints for declared materialized and fused pairs
operator names, actual cardinalities, rows scanned, and operator timings
columns explicitly exposed by DuckDB operator metadata
peak buffer memory and peak temporary-directory size
candidate-specific Mask rows, Mask input bytes, and materialization-byte estimates
measurement_boundary: DuckDB does not expose exact per-operator payload bytes through the current JSON profile. Active-column metadata, cardinalities, time, memory, and spill metrics are observed; all byte-work vectors are explicitly marked as estimates.
rejected_actions: train or tune an optimizer on the EA-0 pilot timings
claim exact engine-internal byte movement from logical byte estimates
change the 11-variant matrix after observing which plan is fastest and still call the rerun the same pilot
reuse Phase 2G as an independent holdout
authorization_if_passed: A passing pilot authorizes freezing the larger EA-0 formal mechanism audit and designing a candidate physical-work feature contract. It does not authorize training or claiming performance for the final Execution-Aware Optimizer.
